$comment: Frozen hosted OIDC route contract. deploy/azure/infra/entra/app-registration.bicep registers the `routes` paths with Entra, HB-11 must serve exactly these paths on the API, and HB-12 asserts the deployed registration against them. Changing a value here is a breaking change for all three.

callback.purpose: Authorization code + PKCE redirect target. Must equal Platform:Authentication:Oidc:Providers:0:RedirectUri byte for byte.

signedOut.purpose: post_logout_redirect_uri landing route after RP-initiated sign-out. Entra requires it to be a registered reply URL.

rpInitiatedSignOut.$comment: Application behavior, deliberately not an Entra redirect URI. The registration declares no web.logoutUrl, so no property of the app registration points at this path and no front-channel sign-out route is registered at all.
rpInitiatedSignOut.purpose: The only supported single-sign-out control. Authenticated and CSRF-protected, it clears the server session and redirects the browser to the Entra end_session_endpoint with the registered signed-out route as post_logout_redirect_uri.

unregisteredFrontChannelLogout.$comment: Kept as a negative contract so the removal cannot silently regress. HB-09 must not declare web.logoutUrl and must not emit a front-channel output.
unregisteredFrontChannelLogout.reason: An Entra-initiated front-channel GET is cross-site, and the __Host-vistara-session cookie is SameSite=Lax, so the browser never attaches it. The API keeps the path only as an inert compatibility endpoint; registering it would advertise a sign-out control that fails open.
